text: Brew Lab, Indiranagar, Bengaluru. One-page site with menu, hours, location and pre-order for pickup. We want a big photo gallery of the cafe AND a detailed story section about each of our three coffee farms. Keep costs low.
Charter recorded. The brief covers purpose, audience and required content; missing facts (prices, farm names, photos) become marked placeholders. @Adaptation, propose workflows.

@Priority Full charter scope prices at 50 against a budget of 35, so I can't fund it all. Priority order: W1 core page (15), W2 pre-order (15), W3 gallery (10), W4 farms (10). If you counter, I would cut W2's form first and keep the gallery and farms together, since the charter bars trading one for the other. Gap is 15 and I'd rather you rule on it than I guess.
